text:
mika: Heads-up — pacific-satellite cluster bootstrapped but we’re seeing intermittent model-server pod evictions and very slow gRPC startup. Opening a triage thread to capture findings and update the bootstrap runbook.

simon: Symptoms? kubelet logs, any OOM or network errors?

mika: kubelet shows lots of CNI ENETDOWN and 'connection reset by peer' around node reboots. sample kernel log: 
```
Jun 11 10:12:03 node-17 kernel: cali-p9s8v: port 5 entered disabled state
Jun 11 10:12:04 node-17 dockerd[1234]: time="..." level=error msg="failed to start container: network failed: ... write: invalid argument"
```
iperf across nodes shows MTU drop: MTU 1500 on calico vs 9000 on infra fabric -> large packets fragmenting.

lee: ah that MTU mismatch will wreak havoc for gRPC streaming + huge model KV transfers. Were jumbo frames enabled on the hypervisor but not calico?

mika: yes, cloud host MTU=9000, calico default 1500. Also noticed some nodes had host NIC set to 1400 by ops template (historical). mismatch matrix is messy.

ops-bot: Deploy failed: model-server:v3.2.1 -> 2025-06-11T10:13:40Z | 72% pods crashloop within 5m.

oncall-bot: Escalation: Sev2 detected for pacific-satellite cluster. Pager sent to @eng-oncall.

ash (typo correction): Ash: quick question — are we using IP-in-IP encaps or VXLAN for calico?

mika: We're on vxlan mode. calico MTU needs to be host_mtu - vxlan_overhead (50). If host MTU differs cluster-wide we need to normalize or set per-node override.

lee: Quick mitigation: lower host NIC MTU to 1400 across nodes or set Calico to 1400, whichever is faster. Commands I ran on node-17: 
```
sudo ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400
sudo systemctl restart kubelet docker
```
That immediately reduced ENETDOWN events for a couple hours during my tests.

ash: Note: setting host MTU is disruptive (restarts), prefer calico config if we can patch via daemonset.

ash: Calico daemonset patch snippet we used in staging: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  FELIX_INTERFACEPREFIX: "eth"
  FELIX_IPV6SUPPORT: "false"
  FELIX_IPINIPMTU: "1400"
```

ash: (verified) patch applied -> rolling restart of calico nodes -> net stability returned.

ash: But also saw GPU device plugin flapping on 2 nodes: nvidia-docker reported failed healthcheck after network disruption. Pods landed on alternative nodes which caused capacity pressure.

ash: GPU logging snippet: 
```
I0611 10:15:21.123456 kubelet.go:345] Registering device plugin: nvidia.com/gpu
E0611 10:16:03.654321 device_plugin.go:98] Failed to allocate device: no devices available
```

ash: We likely temporarily overcommitted because kube-reserved/eviction thresholds were mis-set during bootstrap (we used a default that doesn't account for MIG partitions).

ryan: Good catch. We should gate node auto-join until device plugin reports full inventory. Add to runbook preflight: wait-for "nvidia-device-plugin" Ready + verified GPU counts == expected.

dena: Proposed runbook additions (quick list):
1) Preflight network MTU check: gather host MTU on all nodes, detect >1 unique values, fail bootstrap with a clear message.
2) Calico config verification: ensure FELIX settings match computed MTU (host_mtu - overlay_overhead).
3) GPU device plugin health: require x visible GPUs per node (support MIG count).
4) Kubelet eviction/reserved validation: compare reserved values vs node allocatable, warn if < baseline.
5) Cost note: if auto-failover routes traffic to other regions we may incur cross-region egress -> add explicit approval step for cross-region fallback.

mika: I'll file a PR against infra/runbooks/region-bootstrap.md with those steps. Can someone own the Calico MTU detection script?

lee: I can stub the script — will check host MTU and output recommended FELIX_IPINIPMTU. Will include a safe dry-run mode.

ryan: I’ll take the GPU preflight check and device-plugin readiness probe additions.

ash: Add a troubleshooting appendix entry for "symptom: gRPC stalls + CNI ENETDOWN" with the quick mitigation commands and a note to check jumbo/frame settings on cloud network.

mika: Also note: during this incident we saw a brief auto-scale to our Dedicated fallback in us-west which added unexpected cost (egress + reserved burst). dena, can you add an estimate and a note in runbook about cost thresholds to trigger sales/finance notification?

dena: Will do. Rough numbers: 6 hours of fallback at 3x baseline -> ~\u00248k extra. I'll add exact billing query and an opplay for notifying finance.

ops-bot: Incident closed (mitigated): Calico patched and GPU checks added to bootstrap pipeline.

mika: Thanks everyone. Action items: lee = calico-mtu-check script PR by EOD, ryan = gpu preflight PR by EOD, dena = cost postmortem + runbook note, mika = runbook PR stitching these together. I'll drop links here once PRs are up. :thumbsup:

ryan: :shipit:

lee: starting on it now.

mika: filing follow-up ticket to add a non-disruptive calico patch path in case we need live change in future.
